_readme: Exercise gif/photo library catalog for reps-and-repeats.html (this file lives at gifs/manifest.json, distinct from the app's root-level manifest.json which is the PWA manifest). Each entry's key is the naming-convention slug (lowercase kebab-case of the exercise name); 'file' is the filename within this gifs/ folder; 'names' lists the exact item.name string(s) from the app that should use it. The app's own EXERCISE_MEDIA lookup (near the ICONS block in reps-and-repeats.html) is the copy that actually renders images and must be updated by hand to match this file when an entry is added or changed — this manifest is the human-readable source of truth / catalog, not something the app reads directly.
